_about: Pung-native modules: built for the Push only, from native/<id>/ in this repository. Same entry shape as Schwung's module-catalog.json, plus native, modsrc (the folder under build/modsrc) and deps (source trees a module is built with, synced beside it). docs/NATIVE-MODULES.md.

modules.name: Nodal Red 2X
modules.description: Clavia Nord Lead 2X emulator (Gearmulator Nodal Red 2x): 4 slots, 20 voices, morphing
modules.author: dsp56300/gearmulator (Pung module: rgeissen)
modules.requires: A Nord Lead 2X firmware: one .bin file of 524,288 bytes in the module's roms/ folder

modules.name: OsTIrus
modules.description: Access Virus TI emulator (Gearmulator OsTIrus): TI, TI2 and Snow, with the factory banks the firmware carries
modules.author: dsp56300/gearmulator (Pung module: rgeissen)
modules.requires: An Access Virus TI firmware: the firmware installer's .bin file (about 8 MB) in the module's roms/ folder
